name: What are the typical costs associated with converting a garage into an ADU?

mainEntity.name: What are the typical costs associated with converting a garage into an ADU?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to convert a garage into an ADU varies significantly based on factors like the size of the garage, the quality of finishes, necessary structural modifications, and plumbing/electrical upgrades. It typically includes design, permitting fees, materials, and labor. A basic conversion might start in the low six figures, but a more complex project with higher-end finishes will be considerably more. We provide detailed estimates after an initial consultation and site assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs vary based on garage size, finishes, and necessary upgrades, typically ranging from the low six figures upwards. A detailed estimate requires an assessment.
